notes: Trademark brand of Sears Roebuck & Co. Styles encoded ONLY as presented on Kenmore's own page; no OEM system is attributed or imported from any other page (the page names no OEM for any style). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 2 (decade = 1st letter, year-of-decade = 2nd digit, week = 3rd & 4th digits) — the letter-to-decade table is not stated anywhere in page text and no chart image on the page carries it, so the year cannot be resolved; page Style 3 (year = 1st digit) — single-digit year with no era bound stated on the page, policy-barred. Private-label caveat for coordinator: Kenmore is a Sears trademark brand, so these page-presented styles may originate with different OEMs; the file claims only what the Kenmore page itself states.

styles.notes: Counting tested both ways (Nordyne lesson): digit-only counting gives year '20' but week '78' (invalid, >53); character counting gives 1992, week 7, both valid. Digit-only counting is falsified by the page's own example, so character counting ships: year = 2nd & 3rd characters [1,3], week = 4th & 5th characters [3,5] (1-based converted).
Week = 1st & 2nd characters [0,2], year = 3rd & 4th characters [2,4] (1-based converted). Character and digit-only countings coincide here (leading characters are digits).
